original_eps_requirement: 8 consecutive officially reported single-quarter BASIC EPS facts
numeric_policy: Decimal; explicit observed transformation; raw scale, decimals and precision remain distinct
raw_integrity: Exact archived bytes, receipt, status, endpoint, redirect, length, hash and observed time
fact_semantics: Expanded observed concepts, issuer, market, context duration, scope, unit and fiscal calendar
pit_selection: Externally qualified exact public-version binding and cutoff-specific complete index required
index_trust_boundary: Completeness/public-version attestations are NOT produced by this parser. Engineering fixtures exercise these inputs but are not official attestations.
date_only_policy: Preserve date evidence; SECOND with proven offset required by current candidate selector; do not invent an intraday timestamp
knowledge_time: first_verified_observed_at permits OBSERVED_FORWARD_ONLY; never inferred public time or historical backfill
revision_policy: Select cutoff-qualified version; require superseded version record, not necessarily original raw bytes for post-revision selection
period_selection: Complete official index determines anchor before parsing; bounded ten-quarter window; eight consecutive quarters; no older substitution

source_binding_proposals.returned_identity: Official CompanyID/Year/Quarter/Market/ReportCategory plus each fact's absolute context
